notes.title: Patch 1.09 (Discord rich presence)
notes.content:
We just released a minor update. This update adds support for Discord's rich presence feature. Discord will now show off which level you're currently playing and your best medal on that level.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7703285/ced35194de9ce357677be0d3035bbd3aa6993007.png

notes.title: Patch 1.08 (hotfix)
notes.content:
We've just released a small hotfix patch, numbered 1.08.  This patch contains the following changes:

 Workshop level packs using non-ASCII characters in the pack name or level names will no longer crash the game on startup (or ever).
 Ending C will only play once.

notes.title: Patch 1.07 (Ending C)
notes.content:
We've just released version 1.07, a minor content update! Here are the changes new to this version:

 Added "Ending C: Haste" and the corresponding achievement
 Updated light tile graphic
 Added more props graphics for use in custom levels
 Added more credits slide images

notes.title: Patch 1.06 (save game hotfix)
notes.content:
We've just released Camera Obscura version 1.06.  Here are the changes in this version:

 Fixed a problem where unlocking the Vacation Photos achievement could render save files unreadable.

Affected savegames will now be loadable, but level progression information was permanently lost.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
We've just released a long-overdue hotfix patch for Camera Obscura.  The version number for the patch is 1.05.

The patch includes the following changes:

 Memento #56 is no longer unreachable
 Added an option to disable the full-screen flash effect
 Fixed the controller d-pad not working in menus
